headline: 5 c3 vendors (Pebblebee/Cube/Atuvos/Nutale/KeySmart) are Apple/Google Find-My ECOSYSTEM participants, disambiguated by GATT device-name string (not by distinct BLE company-id/service-uuid). Net-new vendor-distinct identifier surface = exactly ONE: Pebblebee service UUID 0xFA25 (single-source, crowdsourced). No c3 vendor has a SIG-assigned company ID.

leads.db_presence: NET-NEW (0 rows: grep of identifier for 'FA25' returns only a firmware_sha256_hash substring + a Verizon URL substring, NOT this UUID).
leads.source_excerpt: internal const val PEBBLEBEE_SOUND_SERVICE = "FA25"  /  val offlineFindingServiceUUID: ParcelUuid = ParcelUuid.fromString("0000FA25-0000-1000-8000-00805F9B34FB")
leads.corroboration: single-source; NOT SIG-registered (absent from member_uuids.yaml). NO §8.3 lift available. Pebblebee app teardown recommended to corroborate.
caveats: 0xFA25 is the connectable SOUND / offline-finding GATT service — observable on a CONNECTED device, NOT in the passive advertisement. AirGuard uses it as a ScanFilter serviceUuid (PebbleBee.kt:197-200), implying it is also advertised by Pebblebee offline-finding units.

Paired characteristic PEBBLEBEE_SOUND_CHARACTERISTIC = 0x2C02 (PebbleBee.kt:190) is a SIG-STANDARD characteristic ('UGT Features', characteristic_uuids.yaml:1376) — NOT vendor-distinct; do not promote as a Pebblebee identifier.

leads.disposition: CAVEAT — authoritative SIG assignment exists + ALREADY HELD, but product link unproven
leads.db_presence: HELD: identifiers.id=4010, identifier='0x03EE', identifier_type='ble_manufacturer_id', device_category='unknown', manufacturer='CUBE TECHNOLOGIES'.
leads.corroboration: NONE linking 'CUBE TECHNOLOGIES' (the SIG registrant) to the Cube TRACKER product. Could be an unrelated 'Cube Technologies'.
caveats: Do NOT promote/recat to bluetooth_tracker without a cite-paste tying 0x03EE to the Cube tracker (e.g. Cube companion-app dex or device teardown).
Sibling 'Cube' registrants are distinct entities, NOT the tracker: 0x08A8 'Shanghai Kfcube Inc' (held id2874), 0x019B 'CUBETECH s.r.o.' (held id4557).

leads.disposition: Structural finding — FMD trackers share 0xFEAA and are told apart by NAME STRING, not UUID
leads.source_excerpt: name.contains("pebblebee", ignoreCase = true) -> GoogleFindMyNetworkManufacturer.PEBBLEBEE ... name.contains("eufy"...) ... name.contains("rolling square"...) ... name.contains("hama"...)
caveats: This is WHY ble_company_id/ble_service_uuid net-new is ~0 for FMD trackers — the vendor signal lives in the GATT name, not the BLE registry layer.
